name: Ghillie
description: Ghillie is a decoy-state BB84 telemetry simulator and quantum-kernel detector for attacks that hide inside the honest noise of a quantum key distribution link. It gates each attack on a cryptographic predicate over a public value, so predicting which blocks were touched becomes the discrete logarithm problem, hard for any classical monitor yet tractable for a quantum kernel. The repository ships the simulator, both detectors, and the full benchmark record behind every result, including six real runs on IBM Heron processors.
